results.title: Building the Infrastructure for More Frequent Launches in Florida | Blue Origin
results.content:
At LC-36, our footprint includes vehicle integration, refurbishment, fueling, environmental control, and launch facilities. LC-36A, the first newly rebuilt launch complex on the Cape since the 1960s, is being restored following the anomaly earlier this year. LC-36B, currently under construction, will serve as the operational home for New Glenn 9x4.

We recently filed an Environmental Assessment requesting an increase in permitted launch rate at LC-36 from 12 to 50 launches per year. [...] A new vertical integration facility - currently under construction - will support integration of New Glenn 9x4 and strengthen our ability to run vehicle and payload preparations in parallel.

Together, these facilities create the bridge between manufacturing capacity and flight-ready missions.

### Expanding launch capacity

The next link in the chain is launch infrastructure. [...] Launching at a high cadence requires a connected system - one that manufactures vehicles at scale, prepares customer payloads efficiently, supports reliable launch operations, and quickly returns reusable boosters to service. We are building that system here in Florida.

### Blue Origin Announces Constellation Park: New Texas Manufacturing Campus and 2,000 Advanced Jobs

results.title: Walter Isaacson Launches Podcast On Builders of AI, Elon Musk
results.content: Podcast company Kaleidoscope is launching the show, which is produced in partnership in Ramp and distributed by iHeartPodcasts. The show launches Oct. 20 with the Musk episode, and continues twice weekly into January, with Isaacson continuing to tape more interviews throughout the fall. [...] Isaacson is launching a new podcast, The Builders with Walter Isaacson, in which he sits down with Open AI co-founder Elon Musk, Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, “Godmother of AI” Fei-Fei Li, Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei, Palantir CEO Alex Karp, Oculus VR creator Palmer Luckey and more. [...] Isaacson is known for his best-selling biographies of Steve Jobs, as well as the Leonardo DaVinci and, the 2023 release of Elon Musk,which also drew some criticism from some who claimed he did not fully interrogate Musk’s darker side. Isaacson also launched a subsequent podcast, On Musk, with Kaleidoscope.

results.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs  | TechCrunch
results.content:
Nvidia on Thursday launched new open-weight models designed for always-on agents and edge computing.

The Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is a large, 120-billion-parameter model geared for agents used by the enterprise. While it uses fewer parameters than the Nemotron 3 Ultra model, Nvidia says it can deliver similar accuracy in instruction-following and tool-use tasks. [...] At the other end of the spectrum, the company also launched two lightweight Bolt models. These are intended to run locally on the new AI PCs (running the Nvidia RTX Spark chip) and workstations running the DGX Spark. Such PCs, aimed at consumers, programmers and enterprise knowledge workers, are being released right now into the market through partners like Microsoft and Dell. [...] Nvidia claims that the Super VL completes tasks faster than competing models from Anthropic and OpenAI (Opus 5, GPT 6.1 Sol, Luna, Astra) when post-trained on specific agentic tasks. These tasks include document intelligence, financial accounting, scientific experimentation, medical insurance claims, and security attack resilience.

results.title: Exclusive | Nvidia-Backed Startup doubleAI Launches Model to Pare Cost of Compute - WSJ
results.content:
DoubleAI, a startup based in Tel Aviv, is set to debut what it calls a new category of artificial intelligence that can help companies lower their computing costs. [...] Co-founded by Chief Executive Amnon Shashua, who also helped launch autonomous driving company Mobileye, doubleAI has the backing of investors that include Lightspeed Venture Partners, Bessemer Venture Partners, Nvidia and Dell, and has raised $220 million total. Shashua is also CEO of Mobileye, but in July the company said he would step down once it names a successor.
